name: Kunitachi (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kunitachi city emblem in white: an outlined five-lobed flower shape enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Kunitachi, a city in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 September 1967.

features.role: Kunitachi city emblem — an outlined five-lobed flower shape enclosing a ring
